description: Return the latest input-latency / roundtrip telemetry snapshot from the running JRD app. Includes viewer-perceived input roundtrip percentiles (p50/p95/p99/p99.9 in microseconds) and host-side wire-arrival → inject latency. Useful for diagnosing 'why does the remote feel laggy?' — distinguishes network roundtrip from host injection cost.
name: jrd_telemetry
